title: 3D Gaussian Splatting
paper_title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering
core_mech: 显式优化各向异性 3D Gaussians，并通过屏幕空间 splatting 与自适应增密实现实时 radiance rendering。
core_mech_en: Represents 3D scenes explicitly as millions of anisotropic 3D Gaussians (position, covariance, opacity, spherical harmonics) rendered in real time via differentiable tile-based rasterization.
input_desc: 带标定多视角 RGB 图像与 SfM/点云初始化
input_en: Calibrated multi-view images and initial sparse point cloud
output_desc: 可实时新视角渲染的显式 3D Gaussian 集合
output_en: Explicit set of anisotropic 3D Gaussians supporting >100 FPS real-time novel-view synthesis

source.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting

adapter.name: 3D Gaussian Splatting
adapter.mechanism: Perspective Jacobians project anisotropic 3D Gaussian covariances; depth-sorted opacities alpha-compose colors.
limitations: Dense CPU rasterizer with sixteen Gaussians; no CUDA tile renderer, densification, pruning or nonconstant spherical harmonics.
Synthetic teaching data only; no clinical validity or published benchmark is claimed.
